digest.component_or_area: Rebar Janitor remediation and verification system
propositions: Contributor guidance must use each contributor's configured real DCO identity, with Joe Oakhart's bot identity appearing only in explicitly automated workflows
The force flag bypasses all gates including future ones, while ticket-system invariants like the open-children close prohibition remain non-bypassable
Verification must preserve flexible provider-independent parsing and self-healing while rejecting semantically empty review outcomes
Plan review cannot produce a clean pass when ticket hierarchy was loaded incompletely unless the omitted context is demonstrably irrelevant
ChatGPT-specific guidance must document safe Rebar usage when GitHub repository is read-only with unavailable native clone, Gerrit, or tracker access
